description: This file defines the OrderTotal class, representing an entity for order total details within the sales manager web application. It includes fields like title, code, order, module, and value, along with standard getters and setters.

classes.name: OrderTotal
classes.description: Entity class representing an order total component, extending Entity and implementing Serializable with fields for title, code, order, module, and value.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Returns the title of the order total component.

methods.name: setTitle
methods.description: Sets the title of the order total component.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the code associated with the order total component.

methods.name: setCode
methods.description: Sets the code associated with the order total component.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Returns the order sequence index of this total.

methods.name: setOrder
methods.description: Sets the order sequence index of this total.

methods.name: getModule
methods.description: Returns the module name associated with this total.

methods.name: setModule
methods.description: Sets the module name associated with this total.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the monetary value of this total.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the monetary value of this total.
